ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 high-intensity (white/light gray) to low-intensity (dark charcoal/black) pixel ratio across the visible ventral field.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant light-gray interior field bounded by irregular dark perimeter banding (5-15% thickness). Discrete low-intensity circular focal points (spots) are distributed in the medial regions, specifically a cluster of three in the center-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; calculated angle approximately 28 degrees with a depth-to-width ratio of 1:1.5 relative to the notch opening.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern. The right lobe exhibits 8-10 prominent peaks with amplitudes of 3-7 pixels, whereas the left lobe shows a more weathered, rounded sawtooth profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the distal outer edges, transitioning to a steep concave slope toward the medial notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast cluster of approximately 12-15 circular white pixel aggregates on the distal tip of the left lobe; additional scattered white circular scars on the dark trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Five distinct, near-parallel dark linear disruptions (rake marks) on the medial section of the right lobe, oriented vertically relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent mass of approximately 30+ protruding barnacle organisms clustered on the upper-distal tip of the right lobe, significantly altering the 2D geometric silhouette.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'salt-and-pepper' pixel distribution in the lower-central region where light and dark pixels intermingle without forming contiguous blobs.
